# openrouter_scim_group_mapping (Resource)

ScimGroupMapping Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openrouter_scim_group_mapping" "my_scimgroupmapping" {
  boolean           = false
  keep_members_enum = "false"
  role              = "member"
  scim_group_id     = "9f9d5869-724b-48da-a4a5-e5d8480fcbf4"
  workspace_id      = "813c2033-7245-4c1d-8434-1b393eb5d0af"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) must be one of ["admin", "member"]
- `scim_group_id` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `workspace_id` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `boolean` (Boolean)
- `keep_members_enum` (String) must be one of ["true", "false"]

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openrouter_scim_group_mapping.my_openrouter_scim_group_mapping
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openrouter_scim_group_mapping.my_openrouter_scim_group_mapping "..."
```
